debtDetail.title: What is Debt Consolidation?
debtDetail.subtitle: A way to combine multiple debts into one manageable monthly payment
debtDetail.introP1: As living costs rise, many people juggle several types of debt at once—credit cards, personal loans, car loans, and other installments—leading to multiple due dates and interest rates that make monthly cash flow hard to manage.
debtDetail.introP2: Debt consolidation brings multiple debts into a single obligation, often through a new loan or by using collateral such as a house or condo to pay off existing balances. You then manage one contract instead of many.

0.title: One monthly payment
0.description: Less hassle than paying several creditors

1.title: Lower monthly installments
1.description: Repayment terms can often be extended

2.title: Lower interest in some cases
2.description: Especially when moving from high-rate debt such as credit cards to a lower-rate loan

3.title: Better cash flow
3.description: More money left for everyday expenses

4.title: Lower default risk
4.description: One contract makes financial planning easier

suitableItems.1: People with several personal loan contracts
suitableItems.2: People struggling to manage many installments
suitableItems.3: People who want to reduce monthly payments
suitableItems.4: People who want to organize finances before bad debt

debtDetail.collateralTitle: Consolidating with a house or condo
debtDetail.collateralP1: If you own a house or condo, you may use it as collateral for a loan to close existing debts and combine everything into one contract.
debtDetail.collateralP2: Secured loans often carry lower interest than unsecured debt, which can reduce long-term interest costs.
debtDetail.exampleTotal: Total debt of 900,000 THB consolidated into one secured home/condo loan with a single monthly payment.

summaryItems.0: Combines multiple debt types into one
summaryItems.1: Reduces the number of creditors and monthly payments

debtDetail.considerationsOutro: Consolidation may lower monthly payments, but a longer term can increase total interest over the life of the loan. Review the terms carefully before deciding.

about.lead: Full-service finance and real estate experts
about.intro:
WP Property Setthi Ramruay Co., Ltd. is a finance and real estate specialist offering end-to-end services: loans, debt consolidation, home refinancing, property consignment, buying and selling, and rental property management — with over 19 years of experience.

We understand that financial and property management challenges matter. We focus on clear, transparent advice tailored to each client's goals — whether reducing debt, improving cash flow, or generating income from real estate.

debtConsolidation.title: Why consolidate debt with a home loan through WP Property?

debtConsolidation.outro: Our team analyses each case in detail, from initial assessment and document preparation through to coordinating with lenders, so you get the most suitable options.
